summary:
Constellation Energy 受惠於核能發電需求強勁與數據中心電力合約，EPS 顯著優於預期。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）達 2.55 美元，年增率表現優異。
• 營收達 75 億美元，年增率達 23%，顯示電力需求持續擴張。
• 核能資產價值提升，受惠於 AI 數據中心對穩定基載電力的迫切需求。
• 營運現金流強勁，支持公司資本配置策略。
ai_view:
觀點：強勁的財報確認了公司作為 AI 時代電力供應龍頭的地位。短期內，市場將聚焦於其與大型科技公司簽署的電力購買協議（PPA）進展。中長期而言，核能作為清潔能源的稀缺性將持續支撐股價溢價。追蹤指標：核能發電利用率、新簽署的數據中心電力合約規模、以及聯邦能源監管委員會（FERC）對核能併網的政策態度。

需留意：監管政策變動可能影響核能發電的稅收抵免與補貼。；電力市場價格波動可能影響未對沖的發電利潤。；大型基礎設施專案的執行與併網進度存在不確定性。

summary_en:
Constellation Energy delivered a strong earnings beat driven by robust nuclear power demand and data center electrification contracts.
• EPS of $2.55 significantly outperformed the $2.28 consensus estimate.
• Revenue reached $7.50 billion, representing a 23% YoY growth driven by high power demand.
• Nuclear assets are increasingly valuable due to rising demand for carbon-free, reliable baseload power from AI data centers.
• Strong operating cash flow supports ongoing capital allocation and shareholder return initiatives.

ai_view_en:
View: The strong results reinforce CEG's position as a primary beneficiary of the AI-driven power demand surge. Near-term, the market will focus on the expansion of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with hyperscalers. Mid-to-long term, the scarcity of carbon-free baseload power supports a valuation premium. Key metrics to track: nuclear capacity factors, new data center contract announcements, and FERC policy developments regarding nuclear grid interconnections.

Watch：Regulatory changes could impact nuclear production tax credits and subsidies.; Volatility in wholesale power markets may affect unhedged generation margins.; Execution risks regarding large-scale infrastructure projects and grid interconnection timelines.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 2.55 美元優於市場預期的 2.28 美元，主要受惠於營運效率提升與能源價格優勢。
